display.purpose: The zero-padded station number (01, 02…); 36px on phones, 52px from 640px, 28px on a compact station.

headline.purpose: The screen's h1; 28px on phones, 32px from 640px.

headline-section.purpose: A section heading in a pain's detail column.

title.purpose: A station's pain title; 21px on phones, 22px from 640px. Row titles step down to 17–19px.

count.purpose: A stage's count on the line; the board's counters at 26–28px.

body.purpose: Running text, 40rem measure (54ch in detail prose), tabular figures.

label.purpose: A lamp's written state, field labels, muted labels before values; buttons at 15px/600.

caption.purpose: Stage notes, a source's state, the masthead's week data below 1280px.

shadows.name: lamp-rim
shadows.purpose: Structural, not elevation: the dark rim on every lit lamp, amber tag and amber flag on the day board (transparent on the board) so each keeps 3:1 on steel panels.

shadows.name: lamp-off-rim
shadows.purpose: Outlines an unlit lamp in both themes.

shadows.name: rail-ring
shadows.purpose: A ring in the colour of the surface behind a line station's lamp; it cuts the rail so it seems to stop at each lamp.

shadows.name: field-error
shadows.purpose: Doubles a field's red border when it is invalid.

motion.name: tomoshi-step
motion.purpose: The interval between lamps in the «tomoshi» lighting sequence, in stage order, once per run per session.

motion.name: tomoshi-start
motion.purpose: Delay after first paint before the sequence starts, so it is seen.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Lamp lighting (320ms on background and scale) and chevron rotation (200ms).

motion.name: lamp-light
motion.purpose: A waiting lamp goes from off at scale 0.82 to its colour at scale 1.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Button background, border and colour changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every lamp is lit at once and all transitions and animations are off.

narrative.overview:
The page is a plant's andon board. Each pain waiting for a decision is a numbered station with a flat lamp, and the week's run is a production line of stations with a lamp and a count at each stage. A lamp lights when the run pulled the cord for it. Nothing on the page is a feed, a hero or a dashboard tab. There is one board, read top to bottom, with the line that produced it beside it. The look is industrial and plain: condensed type, big tabular station numbers, flat panels on a flat ground, and four lamp colours that mean something every time they appear.

There are two themes and no toggle. `prefers-color-scheme` chooses between them. Dark is the plant's board: graphite ground, slightly lighter panels, off-white ink. Light is «el tablero de día» (the day board): a cool steel ground, near-white panels, graphite ink. The lamp hues are the same in both, and each lamp on the day board gets a dark rim. The light theme is never cream or warm paper. The density is that of an operator's screen. Rows are dense, rules are 1 px, every target is 44 px, and the page works from 320 px wide.

Colour is status and only status. Amber, green and red appear as lamps, as small filled tags and flags, as the current tab's bar and as the focus ring. They never colour running text. Every lamp has its state written beside it in words, so the lamp repeats what the words already say.
keyCharacteristics: Flat lamp discs (amber, green, red, off) with no bevel, glow or screws, and their state always written beside them.
Two automatic themes built from one set of role tokens: a graphite board and a cool-steel day board.
One face, Barlow Semi Condensed, with tabular figures everywhere, so counts line up down a column.
Zero-padded station numbers (01, 02…), the largest type on the page.
Depth through tonal steps (ground, side panel, panel) and 1 px rules. No shadows.
One motion signature, «tomoshi»: on load the lamps light one after another in stage order, 70 ms apart, once.

rules.name: The Written State Rule
rules.body: A lamp never stands alone. Its state is written beside it in words («En observación», which means under watch, or «Con recorte», which means the cap cut items), and the disc itself is hidden from screen readers.

rules.name: The Lamp Is Not Ink Rule
rules.body: Amber, green and red fill discs, tags, flags and the active bar. They never colour text, and green or red text never sits on the graphite ground. An error is ink-coloured words after a red dot.

rules.name: The Never Cream Rule
rules.body: The day board is cool steel (a hue near 248°, chroma under 0.01). Warm paper, cream and beige are outside this world.

rules.name: The Same Lamps Rule
rules.body: The lamp hues are shared by both themes. Only the red is lifted on the board for contrast, the rim appears on the day board, and the off colour changes with the ground.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed does every job, at 400, 500, 600 and 700. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a second family.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number is tabular, so the counts in a column and the figures in a source line up digit for digit.

rules.name: The Big Number Rule
rules.body: The station number is the largest type on any screen that has stations. It leads the station's plate, and the title follows it in reading order.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift. Hover is a tint (6–7% ink over the surface), never a shadow or a raise.

rules.name: The No Bevel Rule
rules.body: Lamps are flat discs with no gradient, highlight, glow or screw heads.

dos: Do write a lamp's state in words beside every lamp, and mark the disc `aria-hidden`.
Do build both themes from the same role tokens (ground, side, panel, ink, muted, line, edge, signal, focus, hover), switched only by `prefers-color-scheme`.
Do give every lit lamp, amber tag and amber flag the 1.5px dark rim on the day board.
Do set every number in tabular figures, and zero-pad station and stage numbers to two digits.
Do separate content with tonal steps and 1px rules, and keep panels at 4px, controls at 3px and tags at 2px.
Do keep every target at 44px or more, and let a short link's box grow to 44px with a negative margin.
Do draw disclosure chevrons from two borders of an 8px square, rotated, so they inherit the muted colour.
Do reserve load-time motion for the «tomoshi» lamp sequence, at 70ms a step, once, and with none under reduced motion.
donts: Don't bevel, gloss, glow or screw a lamp. It is a flat disc.
Don't colour text amber, green or red, and never put green or red text on the graphite ground.
Don't make a lamp colour the primary action. The primary button is inverted ink.
Don't warm the day board toward cream or paper. It stays cool steel.
Don't add drop shadows or lift a panel on hover. Hover is a 6–7% ink tint.
Don't add a second typeface or a monospace for figures.
Don't show state by colour alone anywhere: in a lamp, a tag, a flag or a field error.
